transcript.content: Hi, we have a new contractor starting at Electracom next Monday. I need to get them set up.
Of course. Let me start with your details. Your name and company?
Thanks David. What's the new starter's name and what do they need access to?
Alex Rivera. They need email, Teams, and access to the shared drive.
Is this a full-time employee or a contractor? And what's their start date?
For Electracom contractors, Tier 1 can handle the setup. I'll need their full name, email, department, and manager's name. Do you have that ready?
Yes — Alex Rivera, alex.rivera@electracom.com, Engineering department, reporting to Sarah Chen.
Perfect. I'll create the account with email, Teams, and shared drive access. The account will be active by Monday. I'll send you a confirmation email with the details.

ticket.summary: New starter setup — Alex Rivera, Electracom contractor, Engineering dept, starting Monday. Email + Teams + shared drive access.
